comment: Our own dialogs and records (not the original's: no Blizzard text or art), which the runtime puts beside the
original's (kp_ui_data.c): tools/defs_c.py compiles them as KBIN, KEXT and KLAB, each BIN by
tools/research/scdata/formats/dialog.py build(). koprulu\video.bin: the video options in place of
rez\video.bin (kp_ui_options.c): the gamma (ID 1), then radio groups by ID, the first of each Auto:
the art 10..13, the fog 20..22, the water 30..32, the text 40..42, the portraits 50..52 (none, still,
animated), the lighting 60..62 (Auto, off, on), the renderer 70..72 (Auto, OpenGL, SDL_GPU: its text the
host's API, Metal or Vulkan; at the next start). koprulu\language.bin: the languages (ADR 0016; a glue
popup over pDPopup.pcx, kp_ui_menus.c): OK 1, Cancel 3, the text's label 4 and its button 5, the speech's
label 6 and button 7 (a button's text is the language's own name, set at run time; a click takes the next
language). koprulu\address.bin: the host's address of the join screen (phase N, stage N5; an edit popup over
pEPopup.pcx in rez\gluPEdit.bin's layout, kp_ui_menus.c): OK 1, the prompt 2, Cancel 3, the edit 4, the label 5
shown when the address has no host. "extend": records appended to an original's dialog after its own (their
indices go on from its last): rez\gluMain.bin's Language (ID 11), shown when there is more than one language to
choose; rez\gluCustm.bin's labels of an unverified replay (IDs 39..41, by reason), Load Replay's Import and Export
(42, 43) and Play Custom's Import (44, above Ok: its slots fill the space under the list), shown when the platform
has a file picker; rez\gluJoin.bin's Address (16, beside Create Game), shown when the provider takes one. Each
widget: type (the original's control types), id, flags, rect [x, y, width, height] (the container's on the
original's 640 x 480 screen, the others in it) and text (with flag 0x200 its first byte the hotkey,
\u0004..\u0001 the hotkey's colour). "labels": texts we give an original's records that have none, by
record index: rez\gluMain.bin's version label (ID 10, kp_ui_menus.c's version_label: %s is the original's version
in place of gluAll 3's "%s" of the remake's own). defs/l10n/koprulu-<locale>.json has a language's texts of them.

koprulu\\address.bin.text: The host's address: a name or an IP, then :port if not 6111
No host was found at this address.

rez\\gluMain.bin.10: Remake based on the original version %s
